1CO.12.31.t: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.
s: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.

1CO.13.1.t: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.
s: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.

1CO.13.2.t: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.
s: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.

1CO.13.3.t: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.
s: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.

1CO.13.4.t: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,
s: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

1CO.13.5.t: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;
s: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

1CO.13.6.t: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;
s: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

1CO.13.7.t: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.
s: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

1CO.13.8.t: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.
s: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

1CO.13.9.t: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;
s: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;

1CO.13.10.t: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.
s: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

1CO.13.11.t: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.
s: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

1CO.13.12.t: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.
s: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

1CO.13.13.t: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
s: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

1JN.4.7.t: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
s: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

1JN.4.8.t: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
s: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

1JN.4.9.t: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.
s: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.

1JN.4.10.t: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
s: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

1JN.4.11.t: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.
s: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

1JN.4.12.t: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.
s: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

1PE.4.7.t: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.
s: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

1PE.4.8.t: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
s: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

1PE.4.9.t: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.
s: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

1PE.4.10.t: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.
s: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

1PE.4.11.t: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
s: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

1TH.5.11.t: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.
s: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

1TH.5.12.t: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,
s: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

1TH.5.13.t: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.
s: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake.
Be at peace among yourselves.

1TH.5.14.t: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.
s: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

1TH.5.15.t: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.
s: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.
Command and teach these things.

1TI.4.12.t: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.
s: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

1TI.4.13.t: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.
s: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.

1TI.4.14.t: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.
s: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.

1TI.4.15.t: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.
s: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.

1TI.4.16.t: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
s: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

2CO.12.7.t: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.
s: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

2CO.12.8.t: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.
s: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

2CO.12.9.t: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
s: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

2CO.12.10.t: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.
s: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

COL.3.12.t: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;
s: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

COL.3.13.t: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
s: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

COL.3.14.t: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
s: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

COL.3.15.t: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
s: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.

COL.3.16.t: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
s: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

COL.3.17.t: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
s: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

COL.3.22.t: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.
s: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

COL.3.23.t: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,
s: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,

COL.3.24.t: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
s: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

COL.3.25.t: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
s: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

COL.4.1.t: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
s: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

DEU.6.4.t: Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one.
s: Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one.

DEU.6.5.t: You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
s: You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.

DEU.6.6.t: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;
s: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;

DEU.6.7.t: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.
s: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.

DEU.6.8.t: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.
s: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

DEU.6.9.t: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates.
s: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates.

ECC.4.7.t: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.
s: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.

ECC.4.8.t: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.
s: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.

ECC.4.9.t: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.
s: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.

ECC.4.10.t: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.
s: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.

ECC.4.11.t: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?
s: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?

ECC.4.12.t: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
s: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

ECC.9.7.t: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.
s: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.

ECC.9.8.t: Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.
s: Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.

ECC.9.9.t: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity, for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.
s: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity, for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.

ECC.9.10.t: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.
s: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.

ECC.9.11.t: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.
s: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.

EPH.4.1.t: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,
s: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

EPH.4.2.t: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
s: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

EPH.4.3.t: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
s: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

EPH.4.4.t: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,
s: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,

EPH.4.5.t: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
s: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

EPH.4.6.t: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.
s: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.

GAL.6.1.t: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.
s: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

GAL.6.2.t: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
s: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

GAL.6.3.t: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
s: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

GAL.6.4.t: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.
s: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.

GAL.6.5.t: For each man will bear his own burden.
s: For each man will bear his own burden.

ISA.6.1.t: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.
s: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.

ISA.6.2.t: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.
s: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.

ISA.6.3.t: One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”
s: One called to another, and said,
“Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies!
The whole earth is full of his glory!”

ISA.6.4.t: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.
s: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.

ISA.6.5.t: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, Yahweh of Armies!”
s: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, Yahweh of Armies!”

ISA.6.6.t: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.
s: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.

ISA.6.7.t: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”
s: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”

ISA.6.8.t: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”
s: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?”
Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”

ISA.40.27.t: Why do you say, Jacob, and speak, Israel, “My way is hidden from Yahweh, and the justice due me is disregarded by my God”?
s: Why do you say, Jacob,
and speak, Israel,
“My way is hidden from Yahweh,
and the justice due me is disregarded by my God”?

ISA.40.28.t: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, Yahweh, the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable.
s: Haven’t you known?
Haven’t you heard?
The everlasting God, Yahweh,
the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint.
He isn’t weary.
His understanding is unsearchable.

ISA.40.29.t: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
s: He gives power to the weak.
He increases the strength of him who has no might.

ISA.40.30.t: Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall;
s: Even the youths faint and get weary,
and the young men utterly fall;

ISA.40.31.t: but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
s: but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength.
They will mount up with wings like eagles.
They will run, and not be weary.
They will walk, and not faint.

ISA.41.8.t: “But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the offspring of Abraham my friend,
s: “But you, Israel, my servant,
Jacob whom I have chosen,
the offspring of Abraham my friend,

ISA.41.9.t: you whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth, and called from its corners, and said to you, ‘You are my servant. I have chosen you and have not cast you away.’
s: you whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth,
and called from its corners,
and said to you, ‘You are my servant. I have chosen you and have not cast you away.’

ISA.41.10.t: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
s: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you.
Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God.
I will strengthen you.
Yes, I will help you.
Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

ISA.41.11.t: Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded. Those who strive with you will be like nothing, and shall perish.
s: Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded.
Those who strive with you will be like nothing, and shall perish.

ISA.41.12.t: You will seek them, and won’t find them, even those who contend with you. Those who war against you will be as nothing, as a nonexistent thing.
s: You will seek them, and won’t find them,
even those who contend with you.
Those who war against you will be as nothing,
as a nonexistent thing.

ISA.41.13.t: For I, Yahweh your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’
s: For I, Yahweh your God, will hold your right hand,
saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid.
I will help you.’

JER.1.4.t: Now Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
s: Now Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

JER.1.5.t: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”
s: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you.
Before you were born, I sanctified you.
I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”

JER.1.6.t: Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”
s: Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”

JER.1.7.t: But Yahweh said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I command you.
s: But Yahweh said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I command you.

JER.1.8.t: Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says Yahweh.
s: Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says Yahweh.

JER.1.9.t: Then Yahweh stretched out his hand and touched my mouth. Then Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.
s: Then Yahweh stretched out his hand and touched my mouth. Then Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.

JER.1.10.t: Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”
s: Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”

JHN.11.32.t: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”
s: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”

JHN.11.33.t: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,
s: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,

JHN.11.34.t: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”
s: and said, “Where have you laid him?”
They told him, “Lord, come and see.”
Jesus wept.

JHN.11.36.t: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”
s: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”

JHN.11.37.t: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”
s: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”

JHN.15.9.t: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
s: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

JHN.15.10.t: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.
s: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.

JHN.15.11.t: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
s: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.

JHN.15.12.t: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
s: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.

JHN.15.13.t: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
s: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

JHN.15.14.t: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.
s: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.

JHN.15.15.t: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
s: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.

JHN.15.16.t: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
s: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.

JHN.15.17.t: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.
s: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.

JHN.21.9.t: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.
s: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.

JHN.21.10.t: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”
s: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”

JHN.21.11.t: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.
s: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.

JHN.21.12.t: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.
s: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!”
None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.

JHN.21.13.t: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.
s: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

JHN.21.14.t: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.
s: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.

JHN.21.15.t: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”
s: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?”
He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.”
He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”

JHN.21.16.t: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”
s: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?”
He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.”
He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”

JHN.21.17.t: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.
s: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?”
Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.”
Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.

JOS.24.14.t: “Now therefore fear Yahweh, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, in Egypt; and serve Yahweh.
s: “Now therefore fear Yahweh, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, in Egypt; and serve Yahweh.

JOS.24.15.t: If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh.”
s: If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh.”

JOS.24.16.t: The people answered, “Far be it from us that we should forsake Yahweh, to serve other gods;
s: The people answered, “Far be it from us that we should forsake Yahweh, to serve other gods;

JOS.24.17.t: for it is Yahweh our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way in which we went, and among all the peoples through the middle of whom we passed.
s: for it is Yahweh our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way in which we went, and among all the peoples through the middle of whom we passed.

JOS.24.18.t: Yahweh drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land. Therefore we also will serve Yahweh; for he is our God.”
s: Yahweh drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land. Therefore we also will serve Yahweh; for he is our God.”

LUK.16.1.t: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.
s: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.

LUK.16.2.t: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’
s: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’

LUK.16.3.t: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.
s: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.

LUK.16.4.t: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’
s: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’

LUK.16.5.t: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’
s: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’

LUK.16.6.t: He said, ‘A hundred batos of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’
s: He said, ‘A hundred batos of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’

LUK.16.7.t: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred cors of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’
s: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred cors of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’

LUK.16.8.t: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.
s: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.

LUK.16.9.t: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.
s: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.

LUK.16.10.t: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.
s: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.

LUK.16.11.t: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
s: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

LUK.16.12.t: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?
s: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?

LUK.16.13.t: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will hold to one and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”
s: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will hold to one and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”

MAT.5.1.t: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.
s: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.

MAT.5.2.t: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,
s: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,

MAT.5.3.t: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
s: “Blessed are the poor in spirit,
for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

MAT.5.4.t: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
s: Blessed are those who mourn,
for they shall be comforted.

MAT.5.5.t: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.
s: Blessed are the gentle,
for they shall inherit the earth.

MAT.5.6.t: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.
s: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness,
for they shall be filled.

MAT.5.7.t: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
s: Blessed are the merciful,
for they shall obtain mercy.

MAT.5.8.t: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
s: Blessed are the pure in heart,
for they shall see God.

MAT.5.9.t: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
s: Blessed are the peacemakers,
for they shall be called children of God.

MAT.5.10.t: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
s: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake,
for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

MAT.5.11.t: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
s: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

MAT.5.12.t: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
s: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

MRK.10.35.t: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”
s: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”

MRK.10.36.t: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”
s: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”

MRK.10.37.t: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand and one at your left hand, in your glory.”
s: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand and one at your left hand, in your glory.”

MRK.10.38.t: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”
s: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”

MRK.10.39.t: They said to him, “We are able.” Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;
s: They said to him, “We are able.”
Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;

MRK.10.40.t: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”
s: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”

MRK.10.41.t: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.
s: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.

MRK.10.42.t: Jesus summoned them and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
s: Jesus summoned them and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

MRK.10.43.t: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.
s: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.

MRK.10.44.t: Whoever of you wants to become first among you shall be bondservant of all.
s: Whoever of you wants to become first among you shall be bondservant of all.

MRK.10.45.t: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
s: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

PRO.1.1.t: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:
s: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:

PRO.1.2.t: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;
s: to know wisdom and instruction;
to discern the words of understanding;

PRO.1.3.t: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;
s: to receive instruction in wise dealing,
in righteousness, justice, and equity;

PRO.1.4.t: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—
s: to give prudence to the simple,
knowledge and discretion to the young man—

PRO.1.5.t: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;
s: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning;
that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;

PRO.1.6.t: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.
s: to understand a proverb and parables,
the words and riddles of the wise.

PRO.1.7.t: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
s: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge,
but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

PRO.1.8.t: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;
s: My son, listen to your father’s instruction,
and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;

PRO.1.9.t: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
s: for they will be a garland to grace your head,
and chains around your neck.

PRO.4.20.t: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.
s: My son, attend to my words.
Turn your ear to my sayings.

PRO.4.21.t: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.
s: Let them not depart from your eyes.
Keep them in the center of your heart.

PRO.4.22.t: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
s: For they are life to those who find them,
and health to their whole body.

PRO.4.23.t: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
s: Keep your heart with all diligence,
for out of it is the wellspring of life.

PRO.4.24.t: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.
s: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth.
Put corrupt lips far from you.

PRO.4.25.t: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.
s: Let your eyes look straight ahead.
Fix your gaze directly before you.

PRO.4.26.t: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
s: Make the path of your feet level.
Let all of your ways be established.

PRO.4.27.t: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
s: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left.
Remove your foot from evil.

PRO.6.6.t: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;
s: Go to the ant, you sluggard.
Consider her ways, and be wise;

PRO.6.7.t: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,
s: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

PRO.6.8.t: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.
s: provides her bread in the summer,
and gathers her food in the harvest.

PRO.6.9.t: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?
s: How long will you sleep, sluggard?
When will you arise out of your sleep?

PRO.6.10.t: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—
s: A little sleep, a little slumber,
a little folding of the hands to sleep—

PRO.6.11.t: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.
s: so your poverty will come as a robber,
and your scarcity as an armed man.

PRO.11.9.t: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.
s: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor,
but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.

PRO.11.10.t: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
s: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices.
When the wicked perish, there is shouting.

PRO.11.11.t: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
s: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted,
but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

PRO.11.12.t: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.
s: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom,
but a man of understanding holds his peace.

PRO.11.13.t: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
s: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence,
but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.

PRO.11.14.t: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
s: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls,
but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

PRO.13.14.t: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.
s: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life,
to turn from the snares of death.

PRO.13.15.t: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.
s: Good understanding wins favor,
but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

PRO.13.16.t: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.
s: Every prudent man acts from knowledge,
but a fool exposes folly.

PRO.13.17.t: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.
s: A wicked messenger falls into trouble,
but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.

PRO.13.18.t: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.
s: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline,
but he who heeds correction shall be honored.

PRO.13.19.t: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.
s: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul,
but fools detest turning from evil.

PRO.13.20.t: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
s: One who walks with wise men grows wise,
but a companion of fools suffers harm.

PRO.15.1.t: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
s: A gentle answer turns away wrath,
but a harsh word stirs up anger.

PRO.15.2.t: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.
s: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge,
but the mouths of fools gush out folly.

PRO.15.3.t: Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
s: Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere,
keeping watch on the evil and the good.

PRO.15.4.t: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.
s: A gentle tongue is a tree of life,
but deceit in it crushes the spirit.

PRO.16.1.t: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.
s: The plans of the heart belong to man,
but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.

PRO.16.2.t: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the motives.
s: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes,
but Yahweh weighs the motives.

PRO.16.3.t: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.
s: Commit your deeds to Yahweh,
and your plans shall succeed.

PRO.16.4.t: Yahweh has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.
s: Yahweh has made everything for its own end—
yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.

PRO.16.5.t: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh; they shall certainly not be unpunished.
s: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh;
they shall certainly not be unpunished.

PRO.16.6.t: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.
s: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for.
By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.

PRO.16.7.t: When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
s: When a man’s ways please Yahweh,
he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

PRO.16.8.t: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.
s: Better is a little with righteousness,
than great revenues with injustice.

PRO.16.9.t: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
s: A man’s heart plans his course,
but Yahweh directs his steps.

PRO.17.9.t: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.
s: He who covers an offense promotes love;
but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.

PRO.17.10.t: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
s: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding
than a hundred lashes into a fool.

PRO.17.11.t: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
s: An evil man seeks only rebellion;
therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

PRO.17.12.t: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
s: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man,
rather than a fool in his folly.

PRO.17.13.t: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
s: Whoever rewards evil for good,
evil shall not depart from his house.

PRO.17.14.t: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.
s: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam,
therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.

PRO.17.15.t: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
s: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous,
both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.

PRO.17.16.t: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
s: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom,
since he has no understanding?

PRO.17.17.t: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
s: A friend loves at all times;
and a brother is born for adversity.

PRO.24.15.t: Don’t lay in wait, wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous. Don’t destroy his resting place;
s: Don’t lay in wait, wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous.
Don’t destroy his resting place;

PRO.24.16.t: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.
s: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again,
but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.

PRO.24.17.t: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,
s: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls.
Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,

PRO.24.18.t: lest Yahweh see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
s: lest Yahweh see it, and it displease him,
and he turn away his wrath from him.

PRO.27.5.t: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.
s: Better is open rebuke
than hidden love.

PRO.27.6.t: The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.
s: The wounds of a friend are faithful,
although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.

PRO.27.7.t: A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.
s: A full soul loathes a honeycomb;
but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.

PRO.27.8.t: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his home.
s: As a bird that wanders from her nest,
so is a man who wanders from his home.

PRO.27.9.t: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.
s: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart;
so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.

PRO.27.10.t: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster. A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.
s: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend.
Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster.
A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.

PRO.27.11.t: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.
s: Be wise, my son,
and bring joy to my heart,
then I can answer my tormentor.

PRO.27.12.t: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
s: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge;
but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

PRO.27.13.t: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!
s: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger.
Hold it for a wayward woman!

PRO.27.14.t: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.
s: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning,
it will be taken as a curse by him.

PRO.27.15.t: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:
s: A continual dropping on a rainy day
and a contentious wife are alike:

PRO.27.16.t: restraining her is like restraining the wind, or like grasping oil in his right hand.
s: restraining her is like restraining the wind,
or like grasping oil in his right hand.

PRO.27.17.t: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
s: Iron sharpens iron;
so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.

PRO.31.1.t: The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:
s: The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:

PRO.31.2.t: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!
s: “Oh, my son!
Oh, son of my womb!
Oh, son of my vows!

PRO.31.3.t: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.
s: Don’t give your strength to women,
nor your ways to that which destroys kings.

PRO.31.4.t: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’
s: It is not for kings, Lemuel,
it is not for kings to drink wine,
nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’

PRO.31.5.t: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.
s: lest they drink, and forget the law,
and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.

PRO.31.6.t: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.
s: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish,
and wine to the bitter in soul.

PRO.31.7.t: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
s: Let him drink, and forget his poverty,
and remember his misery no more.

PRO.31.8.t: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.
s: Open your mouth for the mute,
in the cause of all who are left desolate.

PRO.31.9.t: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”
s: Open your mouth, judge righteously,
and serve justice to the poor and needy.”

PRO.31.25.t: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.
s: Strength and dignity are her clothing.
She laughs at the time to come.

PRO.31.26.t: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.
s: She opens her mouth with wisdom.
Kind instruction is on her tongue.

PRO.31.27.t: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.
s: She looks well to the ways of her household,
and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.

PRO.31.28.t: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:
s: Her children rise up and call her blessed.
Her husband also praises her:

PRO.31.29.t: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”
s: “Many women do noble things,
but you excel them all.”

PRO.31.30.t: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.
s: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain;
but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.

PRO.31.31.t: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!
s: Give her of the fruit of her hands!
Let her works praise her in the gates!

PSA.9.7.t: But Yahweh reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.
s: But Yahweh reigns forever.
He has prepared his throne for judgment.

PSA.9.8.t: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.
s: He will judge the world in righteousness.
He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

PSA.9.9.t: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.
s: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed;
a high tower in times of trouble.

PSA.9.10.t: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.
s: Those who know your name will put their trust in you,
for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.

PSA.9.11.t: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.
s: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion,
and declare among the people what he has done.

PSA.9.12.t: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
s: For he who avenges blood remembers them.
He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.

PSA.10.12.t: Arise, Yahweh! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.
s: Arise, Yahweh!
God, lift up your hand!
Don’t forget the helpless.

PSA.10.13.t: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?
s: Why does the wicked person condemn God,
and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?

PSA.10.14.t: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
s: But you do see trouble and grief.
You consider it to take it into your hand.
You help the victim and the fatherless.

PSA.10.15.t: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.
s: Break the arm of the wicked.
As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.

PSA.10.16.t: Yahweh is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.
s: Yahweh is King forever and ever!
The nations will perish out of his land.

PSA.10.17.t: Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
s: Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble.
You will prepare their heart.
You will cause your ear to hear,

PSA.10.18.t: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.
s: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed,
that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.

PSA.34.17.t: The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
s: The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears,
and delivers them out of all their troubles.

PSA.34.18.t: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
s: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart,
and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

PSA.34.19.t: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
s: Many are the afflictions of the righteous,
but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.

PSA.37.23.t: A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
s: A man’s steps are established by Yahweh.
He delights in his way.

PSA.37.24.t: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
s: Though he stumble, he shall not fall,
for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.

PSA.37.25.t: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.
s: I have been young, and now am old,
yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken,
nor his children begging for bread.

PSA.37.26.t: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
s: All day long he deals graciously, and lends.
His offspring is blessed.

PSA.41.1.t: Blessed is he who considers the poor. Yahweh will deliver him in the day of evil.
s: Blessed is he who considers the poor.
Yahweh will deliver him in the day of evil.
PSA.41.1.h: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

PSA.41.2.t: Yahweh will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.
s: Yahweh will preserve him, and keep him alive.
He shall be blessed on the earth,
and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.

PSA.41.3.t: Yahweh will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.
s: Yahweh will sustain him on his sickbed,
and restore him from his bed of illness.

PSA.41.4.t: I said, “Yahweh, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”
s: I said, “Yahweh, have mercy on me!
Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”

PSA.42.5.t: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.
s: Why are you in despair, my soul?
Why are you disturbed within me?
Hope in God!
For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

PSA.42.6.t: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.
s: My God, my soul is in despair within me.
Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan,
the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.

PSA.42.7.t: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.
s: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls.
All your waves and your billows have swept over me.

PSA.42.8.t: Yahweh will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.
s: Yahweh will command his loving kindness in the daytime.
In the night his song shall be with me:
a prayer to the God of my life.

PSA.42.9.t: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”
s: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me?
Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”

PSA.42.10.t: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
s: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me,
while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

PSA.42.11.t: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
s: Why are you in despair, my soul?
Why are you disturbed within me?
Hope in God! For I shall still praise him,
the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

PSA.90.12.t: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
s: So teach us to count our days,
that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

PSA.90.13.t: Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!
s: Relent, Yahweh!
How long?
Have compassion on your servants!

PSA.90.14.t: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
s: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness,
that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

PSA.90.15.t: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
s: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us,
for as many years as we have seen evil.

PSA.90.16.t: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.
s: Let your work appear to your servants,
your glory to their children.

PSA.90.17.t: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.
s: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us.
Establish the work of our hands for us.
Yes, establish the work of our hands.

PSA.103.13.t: Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.
s: Like a father has compassion on his children,
so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.

PSA.103.14.t: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
s: For he knows how we are made.
He remembers that we are dust.

PSA.103.15.t: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
s: As for man, his days are like grass.
As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

PSA.103.16.t: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
s: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone.
Its place remembers it no more.

PSA.103.17.t: But Yahweh’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,
s: But Yahweh’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him,
his righteousness to children’s children,

PSA.103.18.t: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.
s: to those who keep his covenant,
to those who remember to obey his precepts.

PSA.133.1.t: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
s: See how good and how pleasant it is
for brothers to live together in unity!
PSA.133.1.h: A Song of Ascents. By David.

PSA.133.2.t: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,
s: It is like the precious oil on the head,
that ran down on the beard,
even Aaron’s beard,
that came down on the edge of his robes,

PSA.133.3.t: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there Yahweh gives the blessing, even life forever more.
s: like the dew of Hermon,
that comes down on the hills of Zion;
for there Yahweh gives the blessing,
even life forever more.

PSA.147.1.t: Praise Yah, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.
s: Praise Yah,
for it is good to sing praises to our God;
for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.

PSA.147.2.t: Yahweh builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.
s: Yahweh builds up Jerusalem.
He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.

PSA.147.3.t: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
s: He heals the broken in heart,
and binds up their wounds.

PSA.147.4.t: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.
s: He counts the number of the stars.
He calls them all by their names.

PSA.147.5.t: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.
s: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power.
His understanding is infinite.

PSA.147.6.t: Yahweh upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.
s: Yahweh upholds the humble.
He brings the wicked down to the ground.

PSA.147.7.t: Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,
s: Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving.
Sing praises on the harp to our God,

PSA.147.8.t: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.
s: who covers the sky with clouds,
who prepares rain for the earth,
who makes grass grow on the mountains.

PSA.147.9.t: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
s: He provides food for the livestock,
and for the young ravens when they call.

PSA.147.10.t: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
s: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse.
He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

PSA.147.11.t: Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
s: Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him,
in those who hope in his loving kindness.

REV.21.1.t: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.
s: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.

REV.21.2.t: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.
s: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.

REV.21.3.t: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people; and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.
s: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people; and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.

REV.21.4.t: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”
s: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”

REV.21.5.t: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”
s: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”

ROM.12.9.t: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
s: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

ROM.12.10.t: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,
s: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,

ROM.12.11.t: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,
s: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,

ROM.12.12.t: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,
s: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,

ROM.12.13.t: contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.
s: contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.

ROM.12.14.t: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.
s: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.

ROM.12.15.t: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
s: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

ROM.12.16.t: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.
s: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.

ROM.12.17.t: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.
s: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

ROM.12.18.t: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
s: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

ROM.12.19.t: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”
s: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”

ROM.12.20.t: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”
s: Therefore
“If your enemy is hungry, feed him.
If he is thirsty, give him a drink;
for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”

ROM.12.21.t: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
s: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

ROM.13.6.t: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.
s: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.

ROM.13.7.t: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.
s: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.

ROM.13.8.t: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
s: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

ROM.13.9.t: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
s: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

ROM.13.10.t: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.
s: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

SNG.2.1.t: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys.
s: I am a rose of Sharon,
a lily of the valleys.

SNG.2.2.t: As a lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.
s: As a lily among thorns,
so is my love among the daughters.

SNG.2.3.t: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, his fruit was sweet to my taste.
s: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood,
so is my beloved among the sons.
I sat down under his shadow with great delight,
his fruit was sweet to my taste.

SNG.2.4.t: He brought me to the banquet hall. His banner over me is love.
s: He brought me to the banquet hall.
His banner over me is love.

SNG.2.5.t: Strengthen me with raisins, refresh me with apples; for I am faint with love.
s: Strengthen me with raisins,
refresh me with apples;
for I am faint with love.

SNG.2.6.t: His left hand is under my head. His right hand embraces me.
s: His left hand is under my head.
His right hand embraces me.

SNG.2.7.t: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.
s: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem,
by the roes, or by the hinds of the field,
that you not stir up, nor awaken love,
until it so desires.

SNG.8.5.t: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? Under the apple tree I awakened you. There your mother conceived you. There she was in labor and bore you.
s: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness,
leaning on her beloved?
Under the apple tree I awakened you.
There your mother conceived you.
There she was in labor and bore you.

SNG.8.6.t: Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of Yah.
s: Set me as a seal on your heart,
as a seal on your arm;
for love is strong as death.
Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol.
Its flashes are flashes of fire,
a very flame of Yah.

SNG.8.7.t: Many waters can’t quench love, neither can floods drown it. If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love, he would be utterly scorned.
s: Many waters can’t quench love,
neither can floods drown it.
If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love,
he would be utterly scorned.
